<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Burter''' is a member of the '''Ginyu Force''', Frieza's elite squad. In [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]], the raid of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]], he arrives in the final wave with the rest of the squad. He is the fastest flier of the five.
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The whole Ginyu Force is the boss group of wave 5: [[Special:MyLanguage/Guldo|Guldo]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Recoome|Recoome]], Burter, [[Special:MyLanguage/Jeice|Jeice]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ginyu|Ginyu]], escorted by 15 [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza Soldiers]]. The five stay dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking one wakes it up early. Like every raid boss, they glow red.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid Burter has 10,000 health, 70 melee damage and 55 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Elite]] AI tier, like Jeice and Ginyu. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Burter flies faster than the rest of the Ginyu Force.
* '''Blue Hurricane:''' he spins up a whirlwind around himself. Its damage follows his melee damage.
* '''Dodging:''' he can step back out of the way of your hits.
* '''Teleporting:''' he teleports to you when you keep your distance or charge an attack from range.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Burter drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion#Rewards|Frieza's Invasion]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]], the quest '''Burter and Jeice''' has you defeat him and [[Special:MyLanguage/Jeice|Jeice]] together on Namek's Ajissa Plains.
</translate>
